prompt: Explain to me why the president is so damn stupid.
response_text:
I get the frustration, but calling any leader “stupid” usually oversimplifies what’s going on.

Presidents (or any national leaders) operate in really complex environments—limited information, political pressure, competing advisors, public opinion, and tradeoffs where every option has downsides. Decisions that look irrational from the outside can come from different priorities, values, or constraints you might not agree with.

Also, people tend to judge leaders through their own expectations. If a president’s communication style, policies, or decisions don’t match what you think is reasonable, it can come across as incompetence—even if, from their perspective or their supporters’, it makes sense.

If you want, tell me which specific actions or decisions you’re thinking about, and I can break down what might be driving them and where the criticisms are strongest.
